reviews.text: Bayview Veterinary Center is fantastic. Dr. Marco has been incredible with our 10-year-old dog, helping him get right back to his old self. Every tech we’ve met has been kind and skilled, and the pricing is very fair for the quality of care provided. Highly recommend this entire team!

It has been decades since I have been pleased with a veterinarian Ctr. and everyone in the office. From the front desk, the vet techs to the Vets, especially Dr. Allen! These people take such good care of my three pups and treat them as if they are their own.
Friendly, clean, knowledgable, great with my dog.

The facility is clean and inviting, the staff are friendly and knowledgeable, The veterinarians are awesome. They provided a diagnosis and plan for our sweet cat Blanca. The staff and vets are excellent at handling our cat, she was calm throughout the exam. We highly recommend them!

Professional, Patient and very friendly. They helped me get my dog everything he needed to travel overseas with me. The paperwork was handled precisely and I got into Thailand without any problems what-so-ever.

We recently switched to Bayview Veterinary Center after a couple of visits with another local vet, and after our first visit yesterday, we are so glad we made the change.

From the start, both the vet tech and veterinarian were incredibly attentive and thorough. We never felt rushed, and they took the time to really listen, ask questions, and explain what they were seeing and thinking. My dog was comfortable and relaxed with them. What impressed me most was the clear, detailed action plan they gave us. Rather than immediately jumping to more intensive medications or interventions, they laid out thoughtful intermediate steps, what we should be watching for, and exactly when it would make sense to escalate treatment.

The follow-up was equally impressive. We received a very detailed phone call from a different veterinarian (not the one we saw in clinic) who was very aware of the situation and walked through everything with us, answered questions, and made sure we understood the plan going forward. That level of communication and continuity of care made us feel incredibly comfortable and confident in the approach.

It was also important to me to find an independently owned veterinary practice rather than one owned by a private equity group or large corporate network. You can genuinely feel the difference in the amount of time, attention, and thought that goes into the care here.

After just one visit and the follow-up afterward, we already feel like we made the right decision switching to Bayview. We’re extremely pleased with the care, communication, and thoughtful approach and are very happy to have found an independently owned local veterinary clinic we trust.

Great place! Very considerate staff! Easy access and easy underground parking. At our last vet we had language, and seemingly cultural barriers - that's why we left. And why we had high expectations going in. We were impressed, as was our BFFF, Rocky! Thanks Bayview!

First visit to Dr. Marco was great.Updating immunizations, cleaning his ears, he had an ear infection,  treated that and a complete wellness check for my little Maltese Teddy. Everyone at the office was so nice and friendly putting Teddy at ease. So pleased with my new Vet and Staff!!!

I met them 2 years ago at the humane society walk a thon. I have a frenchie so I have gotten to know them quite well. They are excellent vets, don't try to upsale me in fact the first year we won a raffle and they provided us with year long flea rx and a wellness complete  check up at no cost. Since then I have found their prices to be very reasonable.    Frida had 2 cancerous growths which they removed and she is cancer free. I recommend Bayview veterinary center 100%.

We had such a pleasant experience with Dr. Allen & assistant Brianna. They were so gentle, kind & helpful with all my furbaby concerns. The office was super clean with a friendly staff. We will definitely be going back for any future care.

The office staff are really professional and friendly. The visit was conducted promptly and the veterinarian seemed very knowledgeable and caring about our dog. The pricing is certainly quite reasonable compared to other veterinary clinics we’ve been to.
Best Vet in San Diiego! They take care of our 2 English springer spaniels. Great communication and follow through. Highly Recommend

Can’t say enough good things about Bayview Vet Center! From the vets to the front office staff to the techs — everyone here is so warm, friendly and lovely to engage with. My dog loves coming here because of the environment they create. I’ve been taking my dogs to Dr. Benitez for over ten years and she’s absolutely fantastic. The other doctors in the practice — Dr. Marco and Dr. Allen are both amazing as well. It’s also a beautiful facility, which is just icing on the cake!
Great experience.  Everyone there is so friendly and kind.

We love Dr. Allen and Bayview Staff. They take excellent care of Ranger and Cali every visit and actually take the time to care for your pets. Dr Allen always gets down on the floor and meets them in their space so they feel comfortable and relaxed and so he can fully examine them. Highly recommend them for your furry friends too.
Thank you for the 5 star review Jazmin! Please let us know whenever you need anything!

Making appointments is swift and easy. Staff at BVC are cheery and welcoming right in the door. Our dog is pretty stuck to us, but vet tech was able to get him to follow by positively engaging with him. (I’ve previously used vets that treat you animal with you in the room, but since Covid most will take your dog to another room to administer vaccines.) Prefer the old way, but our dog seems none the worse for wear (see “after” photo). Luckily our guy doesn’t need much attention, but everyone here is knowledgeable, personable, and kind.
Excellent!!!

Absolutely outstanding experience at Bayview Vet with Dr. Marco! I would give 10 stars if I could.

I recently switched Vets (from ABC Vet) for my 14 year old cat, and I have nothing but wonderful things to say about this business.

Facility- incredibly clean, almost feels like a hotel for pets, very kind and helpful employees, and they have complimentary coffee & tea available which is just a nice added touch.

Medical care- thoughtful, thorough, and clearly rooted in wanting the best for the animal, and not how much money they can squeeze out of you. Dr. Marco takes the time and energy to carefully explain treatment options, possible side effects, backup plans, and costs. He is patient and kind, and was great with my cat, Brutus.

Costs- They are the most thoughtfully priced vet I have ever been to, and do their due diligence to ensure that your treatment plan is as affordable and accessible as possible.

I am incredibly grateful to have found this Vet, and wish I found them years earlier. Thank you, Dr. Marco & team, for being so wonderful!!
From the greeting to the examination and treatment, this is an amazing veterinary practice.
This is an amazing vet clinic! They are very caring and my dog Zoey loves coming here
Hi Rhonda, thank you for the 5-star rating!
Dr. Allen is the best. He is so kind and knowledgeable. He has taken great care of both our cat and our dog. Very trustworthy and honest. We highly recommend Bayview Vet!
Caring knowledgeable staff. Good understanding of brachycephalic breads

The doctors and staff at Bayview are the best!  Our senior goldendoodle has seen  Dr. Marco for many years. He is compassionate and thorough and helps us keep her healthy and spry.  Everyone in the office is also so accommodating, efficient and kind. Highly recommend Bayview Vet Clinic!
They won’t provide prices until you’re an “established client”. So crazy of me to ask how much an appointment or an allergy test would be ahead of time, and try to budget accordingly. 🤡 …

So glad I was introduced to this vet! Dr. Allen is amazing and so are all of the staff. They really took their time with my dog Riley, answering all of my questions thoroughly. I left feeling much better and happy with our action plan. Thanks for the amazing visit!

I had an excellent experience with this veterinary clinic and would highly recommend them. They helped us with travel documents internationally with affordable rate, while still providing outstanding service(one of the best vet clinic I have ever been)

The facility is very new and the entire staff team along the process is highly professional. You can really feel their genuine care and passion for animals. Both of my cats were very calm and relaxed during the examination roaming in a private room. Communication from all staff members was proactive, clear, and very considerate.

I only wish I had found them earlier, as I would have loved to work with them long-term. Parking is also easier than thought — there is a side entrance inside the parking lot, and from there it’s just a short walk to left till the end.

Overall, this was a smooth, stress-free, and highly professional experience from start to finish. Very impressive!

Dr. Benitez is great.  I followed her over from the animal clinic she was at for many years.  She listens, has compassion for my dog and most importantly,  provided the correct diagnosis and solved the problem. I appreciate it.  Thank You again Dr. Benitez!
Dr. Allen and his assistant Meghan were very kind and knowledgeable. I am a new client and my two small dogs were treated with great care. I really appreciated their service.
Very thorough and very pleasant staff as well as quite affordable

Dr. Allen & the Bayview team are incredible! They are all so friendly yet very professional & so caring for my dog (and me as the owner) anytime we come in. The staff is all very efficient too so I’m rarely if ever waiting & check out/check-in is a breeze. Dr. Allen always answers any questions I have & his follow up on lab work & overall coordination with the staff is top notch! I trust the entire team & highly recommend them!
The clinic is fantastic.  Everyone is friendly and professional.  Dr. Benitez is excellent.  I highly recommend Bayview.

We love Bayview Vet. From the easy parking, cheerful greeting and thorough, thoughtful services, Twizzel confidently walks in, gets settled in the step up scale and settles into the exam room. Even though her last appointment was a bit scary and she left with a cone because of an eye ulcer covering 1/4 of her eye.  Best of all because of Bayview’s excellent care, her eye healed perfectly without any issue. Thank you, Dr Benetiz and staff 💕

Thank you so much for helping my Oreo today. They did foxtail removal from his L front foot and made sure there was nothing else stuck in there and also found that he has ear infection 😊 Dr. Benitez is so amazing and friendly. Also, the staff are amazing. They really took care of my senior baby. Would definitely recommend bayview vet.

Dr. Marco and Dr. Allen are simply the best! My dog had a dental with (nearly) full mouth extractions. Having 2 babies back to back I hate to admit that my fur children had been a tad neglected in the dental category. Being a vet nurse myself I felt embarrassed that I allowed her teeth to get this bad. The staff at Bayview never made me feel bad for it. They were kind and compassionate. Nurse Amanda was truly wonderful! She explained everything to me thoroughly and made sure any questions I had were answered. She also communicated with me all day about everything that was going on, I know how challenging that can be and she did AMAZING. The hospital is beautiful. It is so clean and well maintained. I would recommend Bayview to anyone looking for a primary care veterinarian. I live in Santee and it is well worth the drive because I know my fur babies are getting the best possible care.
The best veterinary doctor I’ve been to! They are so polite, informative and patient with my dog and her anxiety.

Dr. Marco and his staff provide exceptional veterinary care!  His staff is friendly and welcoming. Dr. Marco provided years of competent, compassionate care to my prior little Shipoo who was put to rest at 16 1/2 years old a couple of months ago.
My new little mini Bernadoodle puppy had his first visit with Dr. Marco and his staff yesterday. His exam with Dr. Marco was thorough, loving, caring, compassionate and very informative about my recommended puppy care moving forward. I have full confidence that my pet is receiving the best Veterinary care possible.
I highly recommend Bayview Veterinary Center for exceptional Veterinary services.

The staff and doctors have always been very pleasant and welcoming here and when I needed an emergency visit that resulted in surgery, they did what they could to fit us all in.  The followup has been great too!  Highly recommend!

Dr. Marco and his team have been exceptional. He takes the time to listen, explain clearly, and treat the whole dog — not just the symptoms. We’ve been through a complex medical situation, and his care, judgment, and compassion have made all the difference. I trust him completely and am deeply grateful to have found this practice.
Veterinary was amazing and the staff is so helpful. I will make this clinic my go to for my two dogs.

dr marie benitez saw doodle for her ear infection.  She tested it and cleaned and treated it then sent home some medication and antibiacite and ask that i let her know if it is working. She was very pleasent and thural.

I feel incredibly lucky to have found such a wonderful veterinary clinic.
With one of my little fur babies always seeming to have something going on, having Dr. Allen and his team nearby has been a true blessing.

From our very first visit, I was immediately impressed by Dr. Allen’s warm, kind, and compassionate demeanor. He never rushes through appointments and always takes the time to thoroughly explain everything, patiently answering all of my questions (and there are usually a lot!). His genuine care for his patients is obvious, and it gives me great peace of mind knowing my pets are in such capable and caring hands.

The entire office staff is just as wonderful—always welcoming, attentive, and accommodating. It's clear that this is a team of people who truly love what they do. I'm very selective about where I take my dogs, and finding a vet I can trust wholeheartedly is no small thing. I'm beyond grateful to have found Dr. Allen!

We took our sick pup into see Dr Allen as we haven’t been happy with our regular vet
He was so kind and explained everything thoroughly to us, he gave us options so we could choose our journey, it won’t be a long one, unfortunately.
We are happy to have found someone that cares and that will walk her home when she is ready 🙏💚

We absolutely love this Bayview Vet Center. You can feel how much they genuinely care about the animals they treat. Dr. Allen always takes time to love on our dog and build trust before any treatment, which means the world to us as pet parents.

The staff is kind, patient, and never makes you feel rushed. The office is clean, calm, and well-run, and communication is always clear and thoughtful. We trust them completely and are so grateful to have found such compassionate care. Highly recommend.

I have trusted Dr. Benitez with my dog Sugar for almost her entire 13-year life and gladly followed her to Bayview. She's incredibly compassionate and understanding, takes time to explain options, answers all my questions, and consults with other professionals when needed to get the best plan for Sugar's extensive medical history. I'm so grateful for the thoughtful, dedicated care our dog has received over the years. Highly recommend.

Very Friendly staff, clean and spacious. Toby was not so stressed he actually felt comfortable. The Veterinarian was so helpful with all my questions and was so so supportive and friendly. We will be back soon.
Thank you Corinne for the 5 stars! We always love seeing you!

Drs. Marco and Allen are fantastic at what they do. The staff and techs here have incredible hearts and love on your pets as if they were their own. The chorus of happy greetings every time my pup visits makes my heart happy. Their love for animals is prominent and they really make you feel good about trusting them to take care of your babies. Dr. Marco is a talented surgeon that is led by ethics and will not try to upsell you. We are incredibly grateful to have such a dedicated and compassionate team.
Dr. Marco and his team are simply the best. The new office is absolutely stunning and offers wonderful care to owners as well as our pets.
Super friendly, caring and capable.  Their prices are great and the results awesome.  I have recommended them to many.

These guys are great! Never pressured us to buy into a ton of unnecessary tests. Good vibes from the moment we stepped into the well decorated space. Our old pups felt comfy there. $50 appointment for first timer. Excellent
Thank you Karen!

Dr Allen and his entire staff are so good and kind with my 3 labs!  The desk and the staff who answer phones are qualified, efficient, patient people!  He takes the time to listen to you, then explains everything, gives you plan A, plan B and involves you in that decision. My dog needed a liver biopsy, and his office has an internist that can come in and do it in his office. When the results came back, the internist called me and was very thorough and took lots of time to explain things to me. In conjunction with Dr. Allen they have a plan for treatment for my lab. This makes not only the procedure, but the on going follow up care convenient and affordable. Thank you Bayview Veterinary Center!

Our ten pound Terrior/Chihuahua is getting the best care for her heart condition. My husband and I recommend this clinic in Pacific Beach. My Medicare practitioner’s clinic is right Nextdoor and is nowhere as nice and friendly as this animal clinic. Sorry Dr. Saleh, I still love you.

Can't say enough good things about Dr. Marco and his team after bringing my cat in for a consultation. They were very attentive and caring and took the time to explain everything in great detail.  I highly recommend them.

I have been very pleased with the level of customer service. The staff have been very nice and helpful. I have a dog who is reactive on the leash and they have accommodated us. Additionally I feel that they have been straightforward on what needs to be taken care of and not try to sell us on anything that is unnecessary.

I feel so fortunate to have Dr. Marco caring for our medical special-needs rescue dog, Artie. He is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and present at every visit, and his care has made a significant positive impact on our dog’s life. Thank you, Dr. Marco — we truly appreciate you!
Cassie has been going to Bayview veterinarian for sometime now and we could not be happier with the care she receives.

All of the staff were amazingly genuine and refreshingly friendly. From the front desk, to the doctors and vet technicians. The office itself was beautifully bright, extremely clean and they are expanding! Mr. Hemsworth absolutely loves everyone there and received so much celebrity attention... for once he didn't know what to do with himself Haha!

A few months ago, I was saddened to find none of my little 9yr old boy's fangs could be saved despite brushing his teeth over the years with enzymes. I couldn't afford yearly professional 1k teeth cleanings when he was younger. Everyone remained extremely compassionate, non-judgmental and reassuring. I feared the tooth/gum disease may have reached his blood with how bad it had started to recede his jaw line and that he'd be losing his smile that had saved me from depression.

They did an amazing job, superbly thorough and gave beyond amazing follow up customer service on his recovery (pre and post surgery) and fast working meds that Hemi appreciated. We felt very cared for and I was very confident and safe with him in their hands. As a prior fellow vet assistant; this is hands down the best vet clinic & energy you'll find here. They also were more than happy to send me his xrays to "keep" a memento of his little teeth.

Mr. Hemsworth is smiling bigger than ever and sharing that light; back to work as community ambassador around San Diego. Fully healthy vitals and without any pain. Thank you all so much Bayview Vet Center ❤ I have been referring all of SD & downtown to you. Much Love & further healings to all ❤ Priscilla & Hemi @LadyPriscillaBree

I have been to good vets and horrible vets.  Bayview is great!  They are very kind, punctual, was sensitive to my limited budget and we got great results. They seriously care.  We went in yesterday and am in diagnosis stage, but I am confident my dog is going to be affordably better soon.
Dr. Allen and his staff did a great job making our pity feel relaxed and welcome

Absolutely wonderful experience. Friendly helpful people who actually care and will spend time with you to explain things and figure out solutions.  I'm pretty sure my cat has better healthcare than I do. Highly recommended.

We have moved our 4 dogs over to this clinic and they have been fantastic. We have seen so many vets and specialists through the years, and while I think they can be a bit expensive, you are getting exactly what you pay for at Bayview. Everyone from front desk staff to vet techs to doctor is attentive and truly cares about your pet. The doctor takes the opportunity to review records before even coming into the room and can offer great feedback and thoughts because of this. Our vet tech today even sat and narrated everything to my very anxious pup during the exam. Would very much recommend.

They were fast to get us in for an emergency visit for our animal who seems them. Dr was great! The whole staff was so friendly and accommodating. I really appreciate this vet office! They are very respectful, and been a joy since we switched here.
Hi Josh, thank you for your 5-star review! Please let us know whenever you need anything!

Deciding who to connect with for genuine and well-informed care of our pets is paramount, and frankly, anxiety provoking. I want the absolute for my pup and I could feel that the team here at Bayview Vet ACTUALLY enjoys the craft and wants the very best for my pup and I. Couldn’t be happier with this team and how they treated my pup and I.

I got an appointment the next day when I called and we saw Dr. Allen who was very kind, thorough and felt x rays showed probable obstruction. They proceeded with exploratory surgery, finding and removing obstruction. My dog is now starting is 5th post op day and doing great. So grateful for Dr. Allen and Dr. Marco saving his life!

The staff and veterinarians are very professional, friendly and very interactive with animals. They come highly recommended from good friends of ours and I can see why. Everything was smooth efficient and professional yet felt very comfortable and welcoming. Prices are competitive and my dog was very comfortable there.
Appreciate the great service and knowledge and taking good care of my doggie

Bayview is the best vet we’ve ever been to. We have a sensitive senior dog who absolutely despises going to the vet. Bayview always makes us feel comfortable and does an amazing job with our old boy. Couldn’t recommend them enough to anyone looking for a vet who actually cares about animals!

My partner and I have been taking our pets to Bayview for a couple of years now and our experience with all staff and Dr. Allen have exceeded our expectations. We have hopped around vets for care for our Malinois, and the compassion and understanding for the breed here was something we didn’t think we would ever find. Dr. Allen and his team took great care of her all the way until her last day. I really appreciated how they helped us navigate through such a tough time and loss. I now bring my cats here and I recommend anyone looking for a vet who truly cares to visit Bayview Veterinary Center.

Dr. Benitz is one of the best veterinary doctors in existence, period.

I’ve been seeing her for my cats (now one senior cat) for over 10 years.  She was at another clinic before, and when she joined Bayview recently, I followed her without question.  I did try another vet briefly for some testing because they were closer to where I live and the car ride is always stressful for my cat.  But they couldn’t come close to the love, care and professionalism that Dr. Benitz offers.  If it takes an extra 20 minutes in the car, it's absolutely worth it.

Over the years I’ve also met other veterinary specialists, including dentists and holistic practitioners that just don't compare to her either.  So if you are looking for a Superstar vet that checks all the boxes that's reliable, empathic, knowledgeable, and has a great vibe too, I'd recommend trying to see if you can get in with Dr. Benitz.

We had a great first visit and feel confident this will be a long term relationship for us. Dr. Benitez and Sophia were welcoming, friendly, and provided expert care for my geriatric Golden Retriever and adult Sheltie. The hospital is modern and still cozy and comfortable.

I was so impressed with this office. The staff and the doctor were so kind. I have a very difficult dog and they showed tha they truly cared and want to help find solutions for him. I highly recommend!!
Terrific first experience! Everyone was very kind, competent and thorough. Highly recommend.

Our experience was awesome.  Staff was kind, quick and thorough.  Clinic is clean and new.   Doc was great! Super compassionate and got all of our questions answered.   Great experience overall.   :).
Dr. Marco is a great listener and answered all my questions very patiently. I feel very comfortable bringing back my cat in the future.

I am so happy I found Bayview Vets! All the staff are friendly, welcoming and attentive. They listen to concerns and give multiple options/treatment plans, rather than only suggesting one solution. My two dogs love going, they’re never scared!! Would definitely recommend.

It’s always a pleasant experience here. The Staff is very helpful, caring, compassionate and you can tell they genuinely enjoy their job. They address all concerns you have for your pets needs thoroughly. If you want top quality then this place is it.
Hi Benigno! Thank you for your 5 star rating! We appreciate the feedback. Please let us know whenever you need anything!

Bayview has been beyond spectacular. From the front desk to the primary vet to the surgeons and beyond. They have always taken care of our Aussie pup and the follow up after is always reassuring. Would definitely recommend. Pepper is on the mend from her spay!
Hi Josh, thanks for the stars!! We're happy to have you and your pets here at Bayview Veterinary Center.

My big pittie, Mike, has been Dr. Allen’s patient for a number of years. Mike loves going to the vet because of his loving, good care. I was a bit apprehensive going to Dr.Allen’s new care facility. I shouldn’t have been - we were both met with such calm, caring, friendly, professional staff. And of course, Mike melts when Doctor enters the room. It was the love fest between Mike and the vet technicians that sealed the deal for me. I know he is in the hands of caring, compassionate, skilled, loving professionals. Thank you for taking such good care of my big boy.

I can't say enough good things about Bayview Vet and Dr. Marco. They came recommended by LOTS of neighbors on Nextdoor, and I'm so grateful I found them.

I've been taking my dog (2ish) and cat (13) here for about a year now, and despite semi-frequent, semi-invasive visits (shots, blood draws, minor pokes and prods), my dog is always thrilled to be there.

Dr. Marco is super thorough, and a great communicator. He explains things clearly and will happily answer all your questions. And the rest of the staff, techs etc are so wonderful. You can tell it's a facility full of real animal lovers, and they are all amazing at what they do.

I love this place!!! As soon as u walk in you are greeted by two smiling faces. All the staff is very personable but I have to say Shaneyl is so warm and kind and she’s fantastic @  knowing how your pet feels! I felt heard and had all my questions answered and we discussed options. I highly recommend you bring your pet here!!!!!

This was our first visit to Bayview for my puppy, Daisy, although I have many years of experience with Dr. Allen at another vet office with my previous dog, Duke.  Dr. Allen is an excellent vet and took a lot of time with us to ensure all points were covered and questions answered regarding this new addition and what the next year in vet visit terms would include.  The office is immaculately clean and comfortable with personable technicians and reception staff.  Very pleased with my experience and will of course be returning.
Very happy

I’m so grateful to have the quality care provided by Dr. Marco and his amazing team for my brother and sister King Charles Cavalier puppies. I have a long history with Dr. Marco with my Spaniel who passed after a great life. Thrilled with the new facility across from Mission Bay Golf Course. Adequate parking marked RETAIL under the building.

This was a great first experience with Bayview veterinary. The facilities are exceptional. It was easy to park and enter in a low stress environment for our two dogs. I appreciated the clear instructions for arriving at the location, including the best parking space. They get my highest recommendation.
nice facility, very friendly and professional care.

Dear BVC,
We just wanted to express our heartfelt gratitude for your genuine compassion and loving care of our Clancy Boy. Our experience at BVC could not have been better. During our time there we must have met everyone, and everybody on your staff is so kind, friendly and caring. Dr Marco is such a knowledgeable, skillful and caring veterinarian. His consistently excellent care made Clancy’s latter years so much richer and more comfortable. The compassion shown to him, and to us, by everyone on Clancy’s FINAL visit was beyond gracious and is so deeply appreciated. Thank you all!
Wonderful experience getting set up with great caring group at our second home location!

Great place to take your pet! Just moved to San Diego and heard about this place from a friend. Needed a check up and to treat some fleas and they provided me a no nonsense visit with my dog!

The area is very clean and tidy, and the staff are all pleasant. Our vet tech was awesome, unfortunately I didn’t grab her name, but she was spoiling my Rosie and making us feel heard and valued! Was able to get a treatment same day and my dog is already on the up and up! Will definitely be back here.

10  stars!First visit and I was overwhelmed with the welcoming comfortable experience for me and my dog.Carmen Chantel Brigg ,Dr Allen very professional caring. thorough and listened to me explained everything to me and most of all my dog was calm with their handling.Would strongly recommend them!

Our first visit with Bayview Veterinary Center was great. They were very professional and kind to me and my dog Lady. I didn’t feel rushed or feel like a customer. The staff and doctor were very informative in explaining to me in detail causes and recommendations for my concerns about Lady. The facility is clean and has is very comfortable setting. My dog was nervous at first and hid under my seat, but after a little bit she warmed up and was very happy with her experience. Definitely returning back for my pets care.
The office is immaculate and the employees were very nice. Dr Allen was quite thorough in explaining to us how to take care of our new puppy Pepper 🐶 …

Doctor Marco has been our Vet for many years. He has a beautiful and convenient new office … across from Mission Bay Golf Course.
Multi-purpose building. Business below, residents above. PARKING under building.

We are thrilled to have him & his amazing staff attending to our puppies 🐶

Excellent care, polite and friendly office staff and making every effort to provide timely appointments and feedback. It has bern the best veterinary service we had over decades. I highly recommend this team.
Very professional place, they are nice with animals.

Dr. Allen took good care of my cat BooBoo! She had a lump on her stomach, thankfully was a lipoma but he was very kind and informative! He has also taken care of my cats whiskey and ginnie! 10/10 everytime
Great staff, very friendly, amazing facility, very helpful answering really cared about my pug. I recommend this vet highly.
Dr Allen is go great with my Senior dog.  He's kind and gentle. I really him and his staff.  I'm happy this veterinary clinic 🩵🩵🩵 …

My dog has cancer and became paralyzed a year ago. I looked into a new primary vet for my pup, because I did not feel supported at his last vets during his cancer diagnosis. I wanted to find a care team that would be on the same page of helping give my pup his best life and not give up on him. I needed people who believed that his life still mattered. Bayview aligned with what I was looking for and have made a big difference in appointments and overall care for my pup. They are always excited to see him and give him so much love. They have created a space with people who love what they do and do everything they can for your pups health and wellness. I definitely recommend.
Beautiful facility and exceptional customer service. Great job!
Dr Marco and each of his staff are thorough, thoughtful, LOVE my animals and expert in their care. A world of difference from other centers. Well worth my switch!
The vet was so thorough, the staff were extremely friendly, and the facility was clean and pleasant! And the prices were so reasonable!

Bayview Vet Center has raised the bar. The aesthetically pleasing lobby which is incredibly clean yet warm with calming diffusers throughout including the rooms. We are warmly greeted by front desk personnel by name. We never had to wait more than a few minutes before getting whisked into an exam room. The exam rooms are Dr Allen’s pet names and their handsome portraits proudly hang on the meticulously clean exam rooms. Nice touch 🥰

Dr Allen is a wonderful veterinarian who listened to all my concerns ie potty training, puppy biting and humping with my new Shihpoo puppy Teddy. He gives advice and recommendations that have worked very well. His interactions with my pup are very gentle and caring. He takes his time and I never feel rushed. I trust his knowledge and advice.  The vet assistants are very pleasant and caring. They triage all concerns to make sure they are addressed prior to Dr Allen’s presence. I received a follow up voicemail with Teddy’s with lab results personally by Dr Allen and directions to watch for signs of symptoms necessitating a follow up visit. I found this to be a personal touch that is not the norm making him even more of a gem.  Lastly the costs were very reasonable which makes Bayview Veterinary Center overall a 5+++ place to bring your furry family member.
Thank you Riley! Please let us know whenever you need anything!

I've been taking my pup, Ember, to Bayview since he was 8 weeks old and we love it here! ALL of the staff is so friendly and helpful. We've never had any issues getting appointments, even for emergent situations. When I suspected Ember had an ear infection we were able to get in the same day, and as a pawrent, I really appreciate being able to get him treated quickly! 10 out of 10 recommend Bayview Vet!
